nodes.label: UPCOMING.md — next-release notes source
nodes.rationale: Release notes are written as features land; on a v* tag the release workflow publishes everything below the comment as the release body, then resets the file. An empty file falls back to auto-generated notes — a release should never be blocked on prose.

nodes.label: std/pubsub@v1 action (one-shot pub/sub load step)
nodes.rationale: The driver seam is public (register_pubsub_driver) and an `options` object passes driver-specific tuning through verbatim — that is how the pro build's Kafka/Redis/MQTT drivers take their settings; an unknown driver value fails with the list of registered ones.
